title: General Infrastructure OS Triage
steps: Step 2 CPU: inspect system.cpu.util[,iowait] (>20% -> disk I/O), [,user] (>80%), [,system] (>30%).
Step 3 Memory: vm.memory.size[available] < 10% and growing swap usage.
Step 5 Network & Events: net.if drops/errors and high-severity Zabbix triggers/events.
avoid: Do NOT escalate high utilization alone if saturation and app latency are flat.
Do NOT assume an empty event_get result means the host is down without checking host status and ping.
